report_discrepancies.note: Governmental funds statement: fund columns (p3) show transfers in 118,000 (Employee Benefit 45,000 within the General/Depreciation/Emp Benefit column + Activities 73,000) and out 118,000, but the Total Governmental Funds column (p4) prints 236,000 / (236,000) after a Reclassification column adding 118,000 / (118,000). Recorded as printed (236,000 each); net effect is zero.

notes: Modified cash basis school district; basis = cash. All funds (incl. School Nutrition and Activities) are in the governmental funds statement, so no business-type funds (business_type null). Governmental lines use the Total Governmental Funds column (p4, the continuation of the fund statement on p3). The fund statement's Total column shows transfers in 236,000 and out 236,000 (General 45,000 in/118,000 out, Activities 73,000 in, plus a Reclassification column 118,000 in/out); recorded as printed (the fund columns add to only 118,000 each way; see report_discrepancies). Roll-forward: 3,632,739.82 + 6,030,809.99 - 5,131,768.02 + 236,000 - 236,000 = 4,531,781.79. The 'Local receipts' (2,463,842.55) and 'County receipts' (13,987.98) lines are split into items using the report's own fund schedules (General p6, Special Building p12, School Nutrition p11); the split items add to the printed lines. 'State receipts' kept as one line (mixes state aid, homestead/tax credits, 906.94 nameplate tax; see p6/p12). Zero-amount lines (shown as '-') were not recorded. Balance sheet is the cash-basis Statement of Net Position (p1), governmental activities (only column), no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from p6 budget-to-actual; General Fund expenditures from the more detailed object-level schedule (pp13-17) rather than the function summary on p7 (not double counted); Depreciation Fund (p8) had no actual activity (only budget), so not recorded. The Activities fund uses the per-account schedule (p18, FY2025) rather than the summary on p10 (not double counted); the FY2024 schedule (p19) and prior-year columns are not recorded. General Fund '211 Transfer to Employee Benefit' (45,000, p13) and '913 Activities fund' transfer (73,000, p17) are in section other financing (negative) and the printed GF expenditure total 4,615,374.50 includes them (includes other financing); the Employee Benefit transfer-in 45,000 and Activities General Fund Support 3,050 + 69,950 = 73,000 are recorded as other financing (+). Page 5 budget comparison totals receipts 6,148,809.99 / disbursements 5,249,768.02 include transfers (118,000), so differ from the fund statement; not used. Read pages 1-19 of 19.
